messages:
lydia: Quick sync — Q3 initiative needs sequencing: runtime perf work + infra capacity + security HSM gating. Customer ACME requires HSM + 99.9% latency SLA. Need launch criteria and owners.

nate: Can we scope v1 to batching + prefix caching + routing tweaks? Much lower risk than full quantization.

emma: Infra needs QPS targets to size reserved pools. what numbers should I use?

jordan: From recent soak: ~120 QPS per 8xA100 for 8k token avg. For pilot at expected load we should reserve 3 pools (pilot, canary, prod).

kevin: Security note: ACME contract mandates HSM-backed key material and audit logs. HSM integration + compliance checks ≈ 2w work. That's a hard gate.

lydia: Legal flagged HSM as mandatory. That blocks regular private pilot unless we can do Dedicated with customer-managed HSM. Ideas?

nate: Runtime could implement a temporary KMS-proxy adapter to minimize integration blast radius, but it still won't meet HSM requirement for keys in flight. Can do as demo path.

emma: We can provision an HSM in staging this week for dev + test. Prod HSM needs SOC review and ledgering. I'll start the infra checklist.

jordan: Rollout proposal: canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% with automated rollback on perf/regression. Guardrails: 95th latency < 200ms, error rate < 0.5%. Also automatic fallback to smaller model variant on overload.

kevin: Also need end-to-end audit traces for every inference (request id, model version, KMS envelope). I can drop a minimal spec.

lydia: Actions (due EOD Fri): 1) @kevin — confirm HSM ETA & audit spec, 2) @emma — stage HSM & produce capacity spreadsheet, 3) @nate + @jordan — runtime canary + routing plan, 4) @sales/legal — confirm contract timeline for ACME. I'll update roadmap after this.

deploy-bot: Reminder: cross-team sync scheduled tomorrow 10:00 AM in #product — please add any pre-reads.

emma: adding infra sizing sheet to thread and linking capacity numbers.

lydia: thanks all — will mark launch gating in roadmap tracker and flag dependencies as blockers until HSM is green :eyes:

nate: thumbs up. I'll prototype KMS-proxy this week for demo flows. :shipit:
thread_text_search_terms: HSM, ACME, canary, capacity, runtime, KMS, audit, latency, reserved pools
